title: A payer letter whose patient's names, member IDs, claim numbers and date of birth are written any way a letter writes them (placeholder words or months as names, marks, `ß`, typographic apostrophes and dashes, invisible characters, spacing, initials, `_` or `.` in a number)
assertion: No letter or digit written as an identifier is sent; every placeholder is exact and each place a claim's number was written is that claim's placeholder (the lowest of equal claims); nothing today's redaction replaced is sent, but a deadline or amount it took for an identifier; text without the patient's forms, common phrases, amounts and deadlines included, is sent unchanged; the self-check finds nothing
noFileReason: Letters are generated in memory by the property test, which records where it wrote each identifier; no file.
